briefing.text: Netflix beat forecasts but cut its ad sales goal, and its shares fell about 6%.
SpaceX's AI unit made $7.6 billion last quarter, more than its Starlink business.
OpenAI is reported to seek a valuation above $1.4 trillion before Anthropic's IPO.
A Google Cloud outage in London took Revolut and other UK banking apps offline.
Modern Warfare 4 launches Friday with Very Positive early Steam reviews.

stories.title: OpenAI is reported to be racing to close a round valuing it above $1.4 trillion
stories.summary: Reuters reports OpenAI wants investor commitments quickly, ahead of Anthropic's expected stock market listing.
stories.why: The two leading AI labs are now competing for investor money as well as users.
stories.happened: Sources told Reuters that OpenAI is trying to speed up a funding round that could value it at more than $1.4 trillion. The push is timed to get ahead of Anthropic's expected IPO, which could draw on the same pool of investors.
stories.next: Watch for the final size of the round and any filing that sets a date for Anthropic's IPO.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $1.4 trillion valuation would be among the highest for any private company.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: OpenAI wants to raise before Anthropic goes public.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: AI investors are being asked to pick a side within weeks.

stories.background: OpenAI makes ChatGPT. Anthropic, its main rival among AI labs, makes the Claude models.

meme.bottom: Before the other lab asks for it
meme.take: OpenAI has discovered the oldest rule in fundraising: ask before your rival does.

stories.title: Netflix beats forecasts but cuts its ad sales goal, and its shares slide
stories.summary: Revenue rose 12% to $12.87 billion, yet Netflix lowered its 2026 ad revenue outlook and the stock fell about 6% after hours.
stories.why: Netflix sets the tone for streaming, and its ad business is meant to be its next big engine of growth.
stories.happened: Net income rose 44% to $3.66 billion, Stock Titan reports. Netflix now expects about $2.7 billion in 2026 ad revenue, down from about $3 billion. Co-CEO Greg Peters said some areas had grown too fast, after its biggest job cuts since 2022.
stories.next: Watch for the ad tier's launch in 15 new countries in 2027, starting in March.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Quarterly revenue reached $12.87 billion.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Ad sales are running behind Netflix's own target.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: It follows layoffs and the exits of senior executives.

stories.background: Netflix is the world's largest paid streaming service. It added a cheaper ad-supported plan in 2022.

meme.take: Netflix made more money than expected and still had to explain itself. Streaming is hard.

stories.title: Modern Warfare 4 holds Very Positive Steam reviews ahead of Friday's launch
stories.summary: Early players have given the campaign a Very Positive rating across more than 3,100 Steam reviews before the October 23 release.
stories.why: Call of Duty is gaming's biggest annual series, and early player reaction shapes its launch.
stories.happened: Inven Global reports a Very Positive Steam rating across 3,109 reviews as of October 19. The campaign covers a North Korean invasion of South Korea and moves to New York, Paris and Mumbai. It launches October 23, including on Switch 2, with a new DMZ mode.
stories.next: Watch for how scores hold once multiplayer opens on October 23.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Call of Duty sells millions of copies every year.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It launches weeks before GTA VI.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Activision calls it one of the two biggest games of the year.

stories.background: Call of Duty is Activision's shooter series, now owned by Microsoft.

meme.top: Call of Duty is coming to Nintendo
meme.take: Modern Warfare 4 arrives on Switch 2, where it joins a library of mostly friendly plumbers.

stories.title: SpaceX's AI business out-earns Starlink as revenue jumps 161%
stories.summary: SpaceX made $14.6 billion in the third quarter, with $7.6 billion from AI, and shares rose more than 4% after hours.
stories.why: Its first public report shocked investors with AI costs, so this quarter was a test of whether the bet pays off.
stories.happened: Net income was $4.4 billion against a $1.1 billion loss a year ago, Forbes reports. The AI segment made $431 million operating profit on $7.6 billion revenue, up about 830%. Capital spending was $19.6 billion, $16.4 billion of it on AI.
stories.next: Watch for whether the after-hours gain holds and what SpaceX says about AI spending next year.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Quarterly spending on AI alone reached $16.4 billion.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Revenue grew 161% in a year.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: SpaceX is one of the most closely watched public companies.

stories.background: SpaceX is Elon Musk's rocket and Starlink satellite company. It listed its shares in 2026.

meme.take: SpaceX's AI unit now out-earns its satellites. The rockets are taking it well.

stories.title: DeepSeek open-sources the software that runs its own AI service
stories.summary: DeepInfer, the inference stack behind DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, is now free to use under an Apache 2.0 licence.
stories.why: Cheaper serving software lowers the cost of running AI models for everyone, not just DeepSeek.
stories.happened: DeepSeek released DeepInfer, the production system it uses to serve its models, saying it is meant to cut energy and compute costs, Bloomberg reports. It supports Nvidia SM100 GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 chips. DeepSeek also released a tokenizer tool, deepseek-recipe.
stories.next: Watch for how quickly other AI providers adopt DeepInfer and how it performs on Huawei chips.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Running AI models is one of the biggest ongoing costs in the industry.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Support for Huawei chips offers an alternative to Nvidia.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Few labs publish the exact stack behind their own service.

stories.background: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI lab known for releasing capable models with open weights at low cost.

meme.bottom: Its rivals are reading the manual
meme.take: DeepSeek gave away its serving software, which makes everyone else's price list awkward.

stories.title: Apple moves some iPhone Duo deliveries earlier ahead of Friday's launch
stories.summary: Some US and Japan buyers of the sold-out $1,999 foldable are seeing delivery estimates pulled forward by weeks.
stories.why: It is Apple's first new iPhone shape in years and its most expensive phone ever.
stories.happened: MacRumors reports one US estimate moved from December to November 20-30, and a Japan order moved to October 24. Within 30 minutes of preorders on October 16, new US estimates hit January 25. Apple called demand 'nothing short of extraordinary.'
stories.next: Watch for launch-day stock on October 23 and whether more delivery dates move up.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is Apple's first foldable phone.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $1,999 starting price is the highest for an iPhone.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Shipping dates slipped into 2027 within half an hour.

stories.background: Apple makes the iPhone, the world's best-selling smartphone line.

meme.take: Apple has perfected the art of making a phone feel early by first making it late.

stories.title: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 posts Tamil cinema's second-biggest opening weekend
stories.summary: The sequel took Rs 199.9 crore in India in four days and $31.2 million worldwide on the weekend, second only to Street Fighter.
stories.why: Rajinikanth is one of India's biggest stars, and the first Jailer was a huge hit in 2023.
stories.happened: Jailer 2 made Rs 199.9 crore (about $21M) in India over four days, behind only 2.0 for a Tamil opening, One Mann's Movies reports. It is 2026's top-grossing Tamil film. It took $31.2M worldwide from 20 markets and placed fifth in the UK.
stories.next: Watch for whether it passes the first Jailer's lifetime total in the coming weeks.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Rajinikanth has headlined Tamil hits for decades.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: It is the sequel to a 2023 blockbuster.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It ranked second worldwide on the weekend.

stories.background: Tamil cinema, often called Kollywood, is the film industry based in Chennai, India.

meme.bottom: With a fraction of the screens
meme.take: Jailer 2 needed only 20 markets to finish second worldwide. Hollywood would like a word.

stories.title: GTA VI is now one month from its November 19 release
stories.summary: With a month to go, retailers from Best Buy in the US to Germany's Edeka are lining up GTA VI campaigns.
stories.why: GTA VI is expected to be one of the biggest entertainment launches ever.
stories.happened: GTA VI was first planned for 2025, then May 2026, and now November 19. GamesMarket reports retailers are building campaigns around it, from Best Buy's Gamers Beta to German grocer Edeka listing the game. GamesBeat has reported a PC version for early 2027, unconfirmed by Rockstar.
stories.next: Watch for preload details and any word on the reported PC version.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: GTA V is one of the best-selling games of all time.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players have waited more than a decade for a new GTA.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It launches into the busy holiday season.

stories.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' open-world crime series, owned by Take-Two Interactive.

meme.top: GTA VI is one month away
meme.bottom: Even the grocery store is ready
meme.take: GTA VI is now listed at a German supermarket. Fans had assumed it was still a rumour.

stories.title: Google Cloud outage in London knocks out Revolut and other UK banks
stories.summary: A 'power event' in Google's London region took down banking apps for hours, with Revolut listing 31 services affected.
stories.why: When one cloud region fails, millions of people can lose access to their money at once.
stories.happened: The outage began late Monday Pacific time in Google's London region, Bloomberg reports, and Google blamed a power event. Revolut's app, card payments, transfers and ATM withdrawals were disrupted for hours. Revolut said money and data were safe.
stories.next: Watch for Google's full incident report and any response from UK regulators.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Several banks rely on the same cloud region.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Outages show how much banking depends on a few cloud providers.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Revolut has tens of millions of customers.

stories.background: Google Cloud rents computing power to businesses. Revolut is a UK-based digital bank.

meme.top: Google Cloud had a power event
meme.bottom: UK banking apps had a quiet night
meme.take: A single power problem in London reminded UK banks exactly whose computer they live on.

stories.title: US homeland security orders DeepSeek removed from federal systems
stories.summary: Federal civilian agencies must remove DeepSeek technology and stop buying its products, the Wall Street Journal reports.
stories.why: It is a direct US government move against a Chinese AI lab whose models are widely used.
stories.happened: The Department of Homeland Security has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek technology from their IT systems, the Wall Street Journal reports. The order also blocks future purchases of the company's products and services.
stories.next: Watch for whether other governments or US states follow with similar orders.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: AI has become a central part of US-China technology competition.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Governments worry about where data sent to foreign AI services ends up.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands the same day DeepSeek open-sourced its serving software.

stories.background: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI lab whose low-cost models drew global attention in early 2025.

meme.top: DeepSeek shared its code with the world
meme.bottom: The US government said no thank you
meme.take: DeepSeek had a big day for openness. Washington had a big day for uninstalling.

stories.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort reviews land, with GameSpot calling it the series' best
stories.summary: The Switch 2 sports game, set on Wuhu Island, sits at 79 on Metacritic from 46 reviews ahead of its October 22 launch.
stories.why: Wii Sports Resort was one of Nintendo's biggest hits, and this is its spiritual return on Switch 2.
stories.happened: Nintendo Life and GameSpot gave it 9/10, Game Informer 8/10 and IGN 7/10, Nintendo Life's round-up shows. It has 12 sports including tennis, bowling and thumb wrestling. It costs $49.99 and launches October 22 on Switch 2.
stories.next: Watch for its first sales figures in Japan and the UK after the October 22 launch.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Wuhu Island first appeared in Wii Sports Resort in 2009.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Family motion games sell strongly at holiday time.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It launches in a crowded week with Call of Duty.

stories.background: Switch Sports is Nintendo's motion-controlled sports series, following Wii Sports.

meme.bottom: Your wrist has not fully recovered
meme.take: Nintendo has brought back Wuhu Island, and with it a generation's fear of the bowling swing.

stories.title: Street Fighter wins the weekend with $31 million and $51 million worldwide
stories.summary: Street Fighter led the worldwide weekend with $51.2 million and topped the UK chart with £2.3 million.
stories.why: A hit shows video game films can keep drawing crowds, and it lands in a big year for game adaptations.
stories.happened: Street Fighter took an estimated $31 million in North America and $51.2 million worldwide, the lowest global chart-topper since mid-September. It led the UK with £2.3 million from 594 cinemas and opened in Nigeria with ₦35.7 million.
stories.next: Watch for how far it drops next weekend after a B- CinemaScore.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The fighting game series has been popular since the early 1990s.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Video game adaptations have been reliable earners at the box office.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is being measured against Mortal Kombat II's opening.

stories.background: Street Fighter is Capcom's long-running fighting game series, first adapted for film in 1994.

meme.bottom: The box office gave it the belt
meme.take: Street Fighter won the weekend on points rather than by knockout. The belt still counts.

stories.title: Netflix film chief Dan Lin is out after almost three years
stories.summary: Lin was let go at the start of the weekend, Variety reports, the latest senior exit in a week of Netflix job cuts.
stories.why: Whoever runs Netflix's film arm shapes what hundreds of millions of people get to watch.
stories.happened: Lin took over from Scott Stuber in 2024 and told his teams on Monday, Variety reports. Netflix laid off about 1,000 staff last week. Chief content officer Bela Bajaria has also left and was replaced by Peter Rice.
stories.next: Watch for who Netflix names to lead its film division.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Netflix is the biggest buyer of films in streaming.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: It is one of several senior exits in a matter of days.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It came just before Netflix's quarterly earnings.

stories.background: Netflix's film division makes and buys the movies released on the service.

meme.top: Netflix is changing its film boss
meme.take: Netflix has replaced more executives this month than it has renewed shows. Close race, though.

stories.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 arrives on Netflix, with Hideo Kojima in the cast
stories.summary: The 10-episode standalone sequel to the 2022 anime launched on October 20, and Hideo Kojima returns as Hideyoshi Oshima.
stories.why: The first Edgerunners was a surprise hit that sent players back to Cyberpunk 2077.
stories.happened: CD Projekt Red and Studio Trigger made the series, directed by Kai Ikarashi. CD Projekt Red said Hideo Kojima reprises Hideyoshi Oshima, the character he played in Cyberpunk 2077. Cyberpunk 2077 is $17.99 on Steam until October 26.
stories.next: Watch for whether it lifts Cyberpunk 2077's player numbers as the first season did.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The first season was one of the most popular game adaptations on Netflix.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A 70% game discount is timed to the launch.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Studio Trigger is a leading anime studio.

stories.background: Cyberpunk 2077 is CD Projekt Red's open-world game set in the dystopian Night City.

meme.take: CD Projekt Red would like to remind you the game is 70% off. Purely by coincidence.

stories.title: Final Fantasy Resonance scores 36/40 from Famitsu ahead of its October 22 launch
stories.summary: Square Enix's turn-based HD-2D game gets four 9s from the Japanese magazine, with a reported 70 hours to finish everything.
stories.why: A classic-style Final Fantasy appeals to longtime fans who miss turn-based battles.
stories.happened: Famitsu's four critics each gave it 9 out of 10, Nintendo Life reports. The main story takes about 20 to 30 hours and full completion about 70, per Genki_JPN. It launches October 22 on Switch 2 and PC.
stories.next: Watch for Western review scores and launch sales in Japan.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: It brings back classic turn-based combat.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Final Fantasy is one of gaming's best-known series.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It launches the same week as Call of Duty and Switch Sports Resort.

stories.background: Final Fantasy is Square Enix's role-playing series, running since 1987.

meme.bottom: Final Fantasy fans call that a warm-up
meme.take: Final Fantasy Resonance takes 70 hours to finish. Series fans call that a long weekend.

stories.title: Canadian news publishers sue Anthropic over training Claude on their articles
stories.summary: Postmedia, Torstar, The Globe and Mail and The Canadian Press allege copyright infringement in an Ontario court.
stories.why: Copyright cases like this could decide whether AI labs must pay for the news they train on.
stories.happened: The coalition alleges Anthropic used their content to develop Claude without a licence, breached their website terms and got around copy protections, ChatNewsToday reports. The claim was filed October 6. The allegations have not been tested in court.
stories.next: Watch for Anthropic's response and whether other Canadian publishers join the case.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: News publishers and AI labs are fighting over training data in several countries.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A ruling against AI labs could mean large licensing costs.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The plaintiffs include Canada's largest newspaper groups.

stories.background: Anthropic is a US AI company that makes the Claude models.

meme.take: Canadian publishers want to know who read their articles for free, and they have a short list.

stories.title: Salesforce agrees to buy marketing platform Braze for about $5.7 billion
stories.summary: The all-cash deal pays $47.50 a share, sending Braze stock up about 50% while Salesforce fell about 2%.
stories.why: It is one of the year's larger software deals, as Salesforce pushes deeper into customer marketing.
stories.happened: Salesforce will pay $47.50 per share in cash for Braze, nearly $5.7 billion in enterprise value, Bloomberg reports. The deal is expected to close from February 2027. Braze shares rose about 50% on the news.
stories.next: Watch for regulatory review and how Salesforce fits Braze into its marketing products.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The deal is worth nearly $5.7 billion.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Braze shares jumped about 50% in a day.

stories.background: Salesforce is a leading maker of business software for sales and marketing. Braze helps brands message customers.

meme.take: Salesforce's stock fell 2% on the news, the traditional fee for writing a $5.7 billion check.

stories.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reported to be in talks on a $45 billion compute deal
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports Nscale is negotiating a second deal with Anthropic for about 460 megawatts of computing from West Virginia.
stories.why: AI labs are signing ever larger compute contracts, and this would be one of the biggest yet.
stories.happened: The deal under discussion would supply about 460 MW from Nscale's West Virginia campus using Nvidia Vera Rubin chips, Bloomberg reports. It would be Nscale's second deal with Anthropic. Nscale also faces IPO investor pushback and delays at its Norway site.
stories.next: Watch for whether the deal is signed and how it changes Nscale's IPO plans.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $45 billion contract would be one of the largest compute deals so far.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About 460 MW is enough power for a very large data center.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It comes as Nscale's IPO plans meet investor doubts.

stories.background: Nscale is a UK-based company that builds and rents out AI data centers. Anthropic makes the Claude models.

meme.bottom: So it found a $45 billion believer
meme.take: Nothing calms IPO nerves like a customer who wants another 460 megawatts.

stories.title: One hacker used AI agents to breach more than 100 company websites, Reuters reports
stories.summary: A Chinese-speaking hacker handed much of the work to AI agents, with a campaign that reportedly cost a few thousand dollars.
stories.why: Cheap, automated attacks could let one person do what once took a team of hackers.
stories.happened: Reuters reports the hacker breached the websites of more than 100 companies, with AI agents doing much of the work and limited human involvement. The whole campaign reportedly cost only a few thousand dollars.
stories.next: Watch for which companies were hit and how security firms respond to agent-driven attacks.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: AI agents can scale up attacks cheaply.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is among the clearest reported cases of agents running a hacking campaign.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Security teams are racing to adapt to AI-powered attackers.

stories.background: AI agents are AI systems that can carry out multi-step tasks on a computer with little supervision.

meme.bottom: The invoice was a few thousand dollars
meme.take: AI agents promised to make work cheaper for everyone. Everyone turned out to include hackers.

stories.title: Character actor Richard Riehle, Office Space's Tom Smykowski, dies at 78
stories.summary: Riehle, who worked on more than 400 projects over nearly five decades, died of natural causes in Los Angeles.
stories.why: His face is familiar to millions from decades of film and TV roles, especially in Office Space.
stories.happened: Riehle died on Thursday and his representatives confirmed it on Monday, One Mann's Movies reports. His credits include Glory, Casino, The Fugitive, Free Willy and Bridesmaids, and he played Santa Claus in eight projects.
stories.next: Watch for tributes from colleagues and screenings of his best-known films.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Office Space became a cult favourite about office life.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: He appeared in more than 400 projects.

stories.background: Riehle began his screen career in the John Wayne film Rooster Cogburn.

meme.bottom: And every one of them remembered
meme.take: Hollywood remembers a character actor who made small parts impossible to forget.

stories.title: ID@Xbox showcase reveals A Game About Digging A Hole Together and Mouthwashing date
stories.summary: Microsoft's indie showcase with IGN set dates for more than a dozen games, from Shrek 2 Remastered to Croak.
stories.why: Indie showcases are where many of the year's surprise hits first get noticed.
stories.happened: A Game About Digging A Hole Together launches December 4 on Game Pass, Xbox Wire says. Mouthwashing and The Wolf Among Us Remastered arrive October 29, and Shrek 2 Remastered on November 10. Croak is set for March 2027.
stories.next: Watch for which of the showcased games climb Steam and Game Pass charts.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Mouthwashing was a cult horror hit on PC.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Shrek 2 and The Wolf Among Us are returning remasters.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More than 20 games were shown.

stories.background: ID@Xbox is Microsoft's programme for publishing independent games on Xbox and PC.

meme.top: Xbox showed dozens of indie games
meme.bottom: One of them is just digging a hole
meme.take: The ID@Xbox showcase delivered horror, Shrek and a co-op hole. Something for every mood.

stories.title: Otter.ai raises $320 million without giving up any shares
stories.summary: The meeting transcription company took non-dilutive money from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund and says it passed $100M ARR.
stories.why: AI meeting tools are among the few AI apps with millions of paying users, and this deal tests a new way to fund them.
stories.happened: Otter raised $320 million from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund, which is repaid based on marketing performance, TechCrunch reports. Otter had raised about $50 million in its decade before. It says it has 40 million users and plans enterprise and international growth.
stories.next: Watch for the pre-meeting briefs and live call assistant Otter says the money will fund.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: $320 million is more than six times what Otter raised in ten years.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: The deal is repaid from marketing results rather than paid for with shares.

stories.background: Otter.ai is a US app that records and transcribes meetings and writes AI summaries.

meme.take: Otter found investors who want their money back instead of a slice. Very old fashioned.

stories.title: Nathan Fielder's Holmes film opens to $15 million, a documentary near-record
stories.summary: A24's You Can See Everything took about $15 million from just 855 theaters, the second-best non-fiction opening ever.
stories.why: Fielder has a devoted following, and the Theranos story remains one of tech's best-known scandals.
stories.happened: The film took about $15 million from 855 theaters, about $17,544 each. Only Fahrenheit 9/11's $23.9 million in 2004 opened higher for non-fiction. About 70% of the audience was under 35, and it expands nationwide in coming weeks.
stories.next: Watch for its second weekend as A24 widens the release nationwide.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nathan Fielder's TV work has a large cult audience.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Elizabeth Holmes's Theranos fraud is still widely discussed.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Its 4.8 Letterboxd score is the highest the site has recorded.

stories.background: Elizabeth Holmes founded the blood-testing company Theranos and was convicted of fraud in 2022.

meme.take: Elizabeth Holmes promised results nobody could verify. Nathan Fielder delivered $15 million.

stories.title: People are using AI coding tools to strip ads from their smart TVs
stories.summary: Developers are using Claude Code and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to remove ads and tracking from Fire TV and Google TV devices.
stories.why: Many people dislike the ads and data collection on smart TVs, and AI tools make modding them easier.
stories.happened: TechCrunch reports two GitHub projects for stripping smart TVs. One, cleanyourtv, used Claude Code to find a TV on the network, remove 25 Xiaomi packages and write a new launcher. Another, dumbtv, was built with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Claude models.
stories.next: Watch for how Amazon and Google respond to modified devices.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Ad-free TVs are a long-running wish for many viewers.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI coding tools let non-experts take on technical projects.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: TV makers rely on ads and data for revenue.

stories.background: Fire TV is Amazon's streaming platform, and Google TV runs on Google's Android TV system.

meme.bottom: So the owner asked an AI to fix it
meme.take: Smart TVs spent years getting smarter. Their owners just asked for them to be quieter.

stories.title: Eka raises $150 million for a robot model that uses touch as well as sight
stories.summary: The robotics startup is valued at $1.45 billion after a Series A led by a16z and F-Prime.
stories.why: Robots that can handle everyday objects reliably are one of AI's biggest unsolved problems.
stories.happened: Eka builds a force-sensitive gripper that costs under $1,000 and a 'vision-force-action' model trained in simulation, TechCrunch reports. It says the robot picks about 1,500 objects an hour and grasps reliably over 95% of the time. It is running industrial pilots.
stories.next: Watch for which industrial customers Eka names as its pilots grow.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $1.45 billion valuation after a first big round is high even for AI.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Investors are pouring money into AI for physical robots.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Its founders come from MIT and Google DeepMind.

stories.background: Eka was founded by MIT professor Pulkit Agrawal and former Google DeepMind researcher Tuomas Haarnoja.

meme.top: A robot learned to feel things
meme.take: Eka has built a robot with a sense of touch, which is more than some meetings manage.

stories.title: Steam Next Fest opens with a record 8,000-plus free demos
stories.summary: Valve's October demo festival lists more than 8,000 demos, about double June's event, with ArcheAge Chronicles leading early play.
stories.why: Next Fest is one of the biggest chances for small studios to get noticed, and this one is very crowded.
stories.happened: PC Gamer counts 8,011 demos on the press preview page, about double the June 2026 fest. On its first day, ArcheAge Chronicles led with about 18,000 live players, ahead of Loftia, Output Lag's tracker showed. The fest runs to October 26.
stories.next: Watch for which demos climb Steam's wishlist charts by October 26.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Hundreds of games usually take part.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: All demos are free with a Steam account.

stories.background: Valve runs Steam Next Fest three times a year to showcase upcoming games.

meme.take: Steam Next Fest now has more demos than most people have free evenings this decade.

stories.title: Amazon pledges more than €16 billion for Germany in 2027
stories.summary: The plan covers AWS and AI data centers, the Leo satellite program, Prime Video productions and a Berlin robotics lab.
stories.why: It is a big bet on European AI computing as tech giants race to build data centers.
stories.happened: Amazon plans to invest more than €16 billion ($17.9B) in Germany in 2027, Bloomberg reports. The money spans AWS and AI data centers, its Leo satellite internet project, Prime Video production and a new robotics lab in Berlin.
stories.next: Watch for where the new German data centers will be built.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: More than €16 billion in a single year.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Tech giants are building AI data centers across Europe.

stories.background: Amazon runs AWS, the world's largest cloud computing business, as well as its online store.

meme.bottom: Germany has been asked to sign for it
meme.take: Amazon is spending €16 billion in Germany, with a delivery window of all of 2027.

stories.title: Inception launches Mercury 3, a diffusion model it says tops 1,000 tokens a second
stories.summary: The startup claims its new model beats GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on agent tests while running 4x to 8x faster.
stories.why: Diffusion models write text in a different way from standard chatbots, and speed could make them much cheaper.
stories.happened: Inception says Mercury 3 runs at 1,068 tokens a second with a 1M-token context window, The Deep View reports. Launch pricing is $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.35 per million output tokens. The benchmark wins are the company's own claims.
stories.next: Watch for independent benchmark results that test Inception's claims.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is pitched directly against fast models from OpenAI and Anthropic.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Its launch price is well below most rival models.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Speed is becoming a key selling point for AI agents.

stories.background: Inception is a startup that builds language models using diffusion, the method behind many image generators.

meme.bottom: Mostly about how fast it is
meme.take: Mercury 3 says it beats the big labs on speed. The big labs will reply eventually.

stories.title: Resident Evil holds No. 1 in China and passes $361 million worldwide
stories.summary: The film led China's box office for a second weekend with $9.3 million, as the country's yearly takings run 29% behind 2025.
stories.why: It is one of the year's biggest video game films, and China is a key market for Hollywood.
stories.happened: Resident Evil took RMB 62.5 million ($9.3M) in China, for $55.8M there since October 5, One Mann's Movies reports. It was third worldwide on the weekend with $22.6M. China's box office is $4.67B for the year, down 29.2% on 2025.
stories.next: Watch for how it holds against new releases in China and whether it reaches $400 million worldwide.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Resident Evil has been a hit game series since 1996.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Video game films have become reliable box office earners.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It is past $361 million worldwide.

stories.background: Resident Evil is Capcom's survival horror game series, adapted for film many times since 2002.

meme.take: Resident Evil is No. 1 in China for a second weekend. The undead have excellent staying power.

stories.title: LittleBigPlanet gets a fan-made PC port reportedly built with an AI model
stories.summary: The PS3 game joins Astro Bot and God of War III as PlayStation titles brought to PC through AI-assisted efforts, per Instant Gaming.
stories.why: If AI can port old console games, it raises hard questions about preservation and ownership.
stories.happened: A native PC port of LittleBigPlanet has appeared, and the project says it used Claude Opus 5.5, Instant Gaming reports. The site says Astro Bot and God of War III Remastered have also been made playable on PC through AI-based efforts.
stories.next: Watch for whether Sony responds to the unofficial ports.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI coding tools are being used for ever larger hobby projects.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Unofficial ports raise copyright questions.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: LittleBigPlanet was a PS3-era favourite.

stories.background: LittleBigPlanet is Sony's creative platform game series, first released on PS3 in 2008.

meme.take: LittleBigPlanet reached PC without Sony's help, which is one way to skip a meeting.

stories.title: Apple commits up to $100 million to a US titanium supplier for the iPhone Duo
stories.summary: Apple will invest in Pennsylvania's Perryman Company over three years and says nearly 100 iPhone parts are now US-made.
stories.why: Apple is under pressure to make more of its products in the US.
stories.happened: Apple is putting up to $100 million over three years into Perryman, which supplies titanium for the iPhone Duo, CNBC reports. It also expanded a camera parts partnership with Qnity. Apple says nearly 100 iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro parts are made in the US.
stories.next: Watch for more US supplier deals as Apple ramps up iPhone Duo production.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It comes days before the iPhone Duo goes on sale.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Tech firms are moving more manufacturing to the US.

stories.background: Apple makes the iPhone. The iPhone Duo is its first foldable phone.

meme.bottom: It is spending $100 million to keep it
meme.take: Apple is putting $100 million into titanium. The iPhone Duo is partly made of investment.

stories.title: Microsoft adds tools to rein in risky AI agents at work
stories.summary: New controls in Microsoft 365 E7 and Project Perception rate each agent for risk and let admins block or shut it down.
stories.why: As companies hand more work to AI agents, they need ways to stop one that goes wrong.
stories.happened: Administrators can block a risky agent from making changes, require a human to approve its actions, or turn it off, GeekWire reports. The tools assess individual agents rather than whole apps.
stories.next: Watch for how many businesses adopt the controls and which agents they flag.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Agents that act on their own can cause damage if they misbehave.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Microsoft 365 is used by a huge share of offices.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Every big software firm is pushing agents into the workplace.

stories.background: Microsoft makes Windows and Microsoft 365, the office software suite used by many businesses.

meme.bottom: Now it sells the off switch
meme.take: Microsoft added a button to stop rogue AI agents, and that now counts as product news.

stories.title: Depositions say TikTok executives ignored warnings about child exploitation on Live
stories.summary: NPR reports staff told executives that minors were appearing in livestreams where exploitation took place.
stories.why: It adds to legal and political pressure on TikTok over how it protects young users.
stories.happened: Depositions from TikTok staff, reported by NPR, say executives ignored internal warnings about child sexual exploitation on TikTok Live. Staff said minors appeared in livestreams. The claims come from testimony in legal proceedings.
stories.next: Watch for TikTok's response and whether the testimony is used in court.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Child safety is the most serious charge a social platform can face.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: TikTok has a huge young audience.

stories.background: TikTok is a short-video app owned by ByteDance. TikTok Live lets users stream and receive gifts.

meme.take: Testimony says the warnings about TikTok Live were raised internally and not acted on.

stories.title: Disney agrees to hire most of Character.AI's workforce
stories.summary: Disney will take on the majority of staff at Character.AI, the chatbot company that filed for bankruptcy this month.
stories.why: It puts a big entertainment company in charge of talent from one of the best-known AI chatbot apps.
stories.happened: TechCrunch reports Disney has agreed to hire most of Character.AI's employees. Character.AI filed for bankruptcy earlier in October, about five years after it launched. The rest of the company's assets are being handled in its Chapter 11 case.
stories.next: Watch for what Disney plans to build with the team and who buys Character.AI's remaining assets.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Disney owns some of the most valuable characters in entertainment.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Character.AI's collapse shows how hard AI chatbot apps are to sustain.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Big companies keep hiring whole AI teams instead of buying firms outright.

stories.background: Character.AI lets users chat with AI characters. It is one of the most popular AI companion apps.

meme.take: Disney already owns most famous characters, so it moved on to the people who write them.

stories.title: Meta details Prometheus, its gigawatt-scale AI supercluster in Ohio
stories.summary: Meta's engineers say the New Albany site links hundreds of thousands of GPUs, aiming for about a million to train Muse models.
stories.why: Meta is spending heavily on AI computing, and its earnings this week will put that spending in focus.
stories.happened: In an engineering post, Meta said phase one of Prometheus connects hundreds of thousands of GPUs, with a target of about one million for Muse training. It reports more than 85% pre-training goodput and a 99% cut in the interruption rate.
stories.next: Watch for what Meta says about AI spending when it reports earnings today, October 21.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: A million GPUs would be among the largest AI clusters announced.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Clusters like this cost tens of billions of dollars.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The post lands two days before Meta's quarterly results.

stories.background: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp and trains its own AI models, now under the Muse name.

meme.bottom: The power bill runs nonstop too
meme.take: Meta's supercluster now runs smoothly enough that only investors get interrupted.

stories.title: Taylor Swift's The Life of a Showgirl spends a 15th week at No. 1
stories.summary: Swift's album leads the Billboard 200 again, ahead of Olivia Rodrigo, Morgan Wallen, Ella Langley and Noah Kahan.
stories.why: Fifteen weeks on top is a rare run for any album in the streaming era.
stories.happened: The Life of a Showgirl topped the chart dated October 18 for its 15th week, RGM reports, taking Swift to 101 career weeks at No. 1. Olivia Rodrigo's latest album rose to No. 2 and Morgan Wallen's I'm The Problem to No. 3.
stories.next: Watch for whether a new release can end Swift's run in the coming weeks.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Swift is the biggest-selling artist of the decade.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Her career total passed 100 weeks at No. 1.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Rodrigo and Wallen are close behind.

stories.background: The Billboard 200 ranks the most popular albums in the US each week by sales and streams.

meme.take: The Billboard 200 has become a weekly chart with one fixed answer and four guesses.

stories.title: AI-made clone games are pushing indie developers to hide their demos
stories.summary: PC Gamer reports quick AI-built copies of new indie hits, with one studio cancelling its Steam demo for fear of clones.
stories.why: If a demo can be copied in days, small studios lose their main way to find players.
stories.happened: At least seven Roblox clones of Escape the Walls appeared within nine days, PC Gamer reports. Alliance Arts cancelled its Drunken Goddess Reflux demo over fears of AI copies. NoGlyph says another game copied its Needle In A Haystack code and has filed a notice with Valve.
stories.next: Watch for how Valve handles the Needle In A Haystack copyright notice.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI coding tools have made it fast to copy simple games.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Studios may stop releasing demos to protect their ideas.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Developers disagree on how much AI use is fair.

stories.background: Steam is Valve's PC game store, where free demos help small studios find an audience.

meme.top: A studio made a new game
meme.take: Indie developers have found the perfect protection against copying: never showing anyone.

stories.title: US blacklists Chinese investor MiraclePlus over a Google AI secrets case
stories.summary: MiraclePlus, often called China's Y Combinator, funded a startup founded by a man convicted of stealing Google's AI trade secrets.
stories.why: It shows Washington widening its fight over AI technology from chips to the investors behind startups.
stories.happened: The US sanctioned MiraclePlus for financing Zhisuan, founded by Ding Linwei, who was convicted this year of stealing Google AI trade secrets, Bloomberg reports. The State Department action covers five Chinese entities.
stories.next: Watch for China's response and whether more investors are added to the list.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: AI is at the centre of US-China tech competition.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The case involves Google's AI technology.

stories.background: MiraclePlus is a Beijing startup accelerator founded by former Y Combinator China head Lu Qi.

meme.top: A startup ran on Google's secrets
meme.take: MiraclePlus backed a founder with a remarkable head start. Washington asked where from.

stories.title: Benny Safdie's Lizard Music adds Colman Domingo, Jeff Goldblum and Rachel McAdams
stories.summary: A24 has set the Daniel Pinkwater adaptation, starring Dwayne Johnson, for Christmas Day 2027.
stories.why: Safdie and Johnson are reuniting after The Smashing Machine, on a much stranger project.
stories.happened: Domingo, Goldblum, McAdams and David Krumholtz join the voice cast, The Playlist reports. Johnson plays Chicken Man in the story of a boy who finds lizard musicians on TV. Safdie co-wrote the script with Ronald Bronstein, and VFX will create the lizards.
stories.next: Watch for a first look at the lizard band and more casting.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Dwayne Johnson leads a cast of well-known actors.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Pinkwater's 1976 novel has a loyal following.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: A singing lizard band is unusual even for A24.

stories.background: Daniel Pinkwater is an American children's author. Lizard Music is one of his best-known novels.

meme.top: Jeff Goldblum joins a lizard band
meme.take: A24 cast Jeff Goldblum in a film about lizard musicians. The casting wrote itself.

stories.title: Nintendo says it underestimated demand for its Zelda Switch 2 console
stories.summary: A Nintendo executive apologised for shortages of the Zelda 40th Anniversary console and promised restocks, without a date.
stories.why: Shortages of a collector's console ahead of the holidays frustrate fans and hint at strong demand.
stories.happened: Bill van Zyll, Nintendo's Latin America chief, said the company underestimated demand and that restocks are coming but will take time, Nintendo Life reports. He singled out North America. The Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 arrives November 5.
stories.next: Watch for restock dates and sales when the Ocarina of Time remake launches on November 5.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The Legend of Zelda turns 40 this year.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The special console has been selling out at retailers.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Shortages are hitting just before the holidays.

stories.background: The Legend of Zelda is Nintendo's adventure series. The Switch 2 is Nintendo's current console.

meme.top: Nintendo thought Zelda fans could wait
meme.take: Nintendo underestimated demand for a Zelda console, which is a bold thing to underestimate.

stories.title: Burger King Japan discloses a breach of 11.18 million customer records
stories.summary: Names, birth dates, contact details and order histories, mostly from app users, were exposed in early October.
stories.why: Millions of real names and phone numbers in one leak make convincing phishing much easier.
stories.happened: The company says unauthorized access happened between October 2 and 7 and was confirmed on October 13, TechRadar reports. Exposed data includes names, birth dates, genders, emails, phone numbers and order histories. Payment card data was not exposed.
stories.next: Watch for notices to affected customers and any phishing that uses the leaked details.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More than 11 million records were exposed.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Contact details plus order history can make scams look genuine.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Burger King is a global fast-food brand.

stories.background: Burger King Japan runs the fast-food chain's restaurants and ordering app in Japan.

meme.take: The hackers got your name, number and order history, but not the card. Small mercies.

stories.title: Funcom lays off staff after Dune: Awakening's console launch
stories.summary: The studio is restructuring as the survival game shifts to a games-as-a-service model, a month after reaching PS5 and Xbox.
stories.why: Layoffs after a big launch show how tough the games business remains.
stories.happened: Dune: Awakening launched on Xbox Series and PS5 on September 22, Instant Gaming reports. Funcom says it is restructuring because the game now runs as a live service, and part of its staff is being let go.
stories.next: Watch for how many roles are cut and Funcom's update plans for Dune: Awakening.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Job cuts continue across the games industry.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Dune is a major science fiction franchise.

stories.background: Funcom is a Norwegian game studio known for Conan Exiles and Dune: Awakening.

meme.take: The spice must flow, and in this case so must the restructuring.

stories.title: Tamil film composer Deva dies at 75
stories.summary: The composer and singer, who scored more than 400 films and pioneered gaana music in cinema, died in Chennai.
stories.why: Deva's songs shaped decades of South Indian film music, including Rajinikanth classics.
stories.happened: Deva died of sudden cardiac arrest on Saturday at a Chennai hospital, One Mann's Movies reports. He composed for more than 400 films in Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam, including Annaamalai and Baashha. He received full state honours at his burial on Sunday.
stories.next: Watch for tributes and screenings honouring his work in Tamil cinema.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Deva was one of Tamil cinema's best-known composers.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: His 1990s songs remain widely loved.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: He scored more than 400 films.

stories.background: Deva was known as 'Thenisai Thendral' and was famed for bringing Chennai's gaana folk style to film.

meme.bottom: Their songs are still being played
meme.take: Tamil cinema remembers a composer whose music outlasts any headline.
